query_text: Find the best deals for laptops online.

parts.text:
With Amazon moving **Prime Day 2026 earlier to June 23–26** and competitors like Best Buy launching their own massive counters (such as the **Summer Tech Fest starting June 22**), we are currently in an aggressive early-summer price war. 

The best online laptop deals are categorized below by use case, highlighting verified price drops across major retailers:

---

### 1. Best MacBook Deals
*   **Apple MacBook Air 15-inch (M5, 2026)**
    *   **The Deal:** **$1,149** (was $1,299 — Save $150)
    *   **Where:** Best Buy / Amazon
    *   **Specs:** Apple M5 chip, 16GB unified memory, 512GB SSD. 
    *   **Why it’s great:** This is the latest 2026 revision with Apple’s cutting-edge M5 chip, offering elite battery life and top-tier performance for a great discount.
*   **Apple MacBook Air 13-inch (M4, 2025)**
    *   **The Deal:** **$1,099** (was $1,399 — Save $300)
    *   **Where:** Best Buy
    *   **Specs:** M4 processor, 24GB RAM, 512GB SSD, 13-inch Liquid Retina display.
    *   **Why it’s great:** For those who want more RAM, this 2025 model boasts a massive 24GB of unified memory—making it highly future-proof against memory-hungry local AI models.

---

### 2. Best Windows Productivity & Copilot+ Deals
*   **Lenovo ThinkPad E16 (Gen 3)**
    *   **The Deal:** **$1,289** (was $1,799 — Save $510)
    *   **Where:** Amazon
    *   **Specs:** Intel Core Ultra 7 255H CPU, 16GB RAM, 512GB SSD, 16-inch 1200p display.
    *   **Why it’s great:** Excellent professional build quality, best-in-class keyboard, and a beautiful bright screen that fixes the display complaints of previous generations.
*   **HP OmniBook X Flip 2-in-1 16" Touchscreen**
    *   **The Deal:** **$899.99** (was $1,349 — Save $450)
    *   **Where:** Best Buy
    *   **Specs:** Intel Core Ultra 5 CPU, 16GB RAM, 512GB SSD, 2K OLED Touchscreen.
    *   **Why it’s great:** A massive price drop on a premium 2-in-1. The OLED touchscreen and high efficiency make it an incredibly versatile daily driver.
*   **Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3x (Copilot+ PC)**
    *   **The Deal:** **$599.99** (was $849 — Save $250)
    *   **Where:** Best Buy
    *   **Specs:** Snapdragon X Plus, 16GB RAM, 256GB SSD, 15.3" 2K Touchscreen.
    *   **Why it’s great:** If you want elite "all-day" battery life (20+ hours) and local Copilot+ AI features on a budget, this Snapdragon-powered ultraportable is an absolute steal.

---

### 3. Best Gaming Laptop Deals
*   **ASUS ROG Zephyrus G16 (OLED, 2026)**
    *   **The Deal:** **$3,799.99** (was $4,400 — Save $600)
    *   **Where:** Best Buy
    *   **Specs:** Intel Core Ultra 9 285H, **NVIDIA RTX 5090 GPU**, 32GB RAM, 2TB SSD, 16-inch 2.5K OLED (240Hz).
    *   **Why it’s great:** This is the lowest tracked price on an elite Blackwell RTX 5090 gaming rig. It is incredibly thin and boasts an amazing OLED display. 
*   **Acer Predator Helios Neo 16**
    *   **The Deal:** **$1,909** (was $2,199 — Save $290)
    *   **Where:** Amazon
    *   **Why it’s great:** A powerhouse machine for users who want premium gaming capabilities without crossing the $2,000 threshold. 

---

### 4. Best Budget Laptop Deals (Under $500)
*   **Acer Aspire (15.6-inch)**
    *   **The Deal:** **$279.99** (was $499.99 — Save $220)
    *   **Where:** Best Buy
    *   **Specs:** 8GB RAM, 128GB SSD. 
    *   **Why it’s great:** A highly capable, simple, budget-friendly notebook perfect for students or casual browsing.
*   **Windows 11 Pro 15.6" Laptop**
    *   **The Deal:** **$329.39** (was $619.99 — Save ~$290)
    *   **Where:** Walmart (Flash Deal)
    *   **Specs:** 12th Gen Intel N100, 12GB RAM, 512GB SSD, FHD display.
    *   **Why it’s great:** Highly rated for college students, business, or home use with a robust 12GB of RAM for easy multitasking.

---

### 💡 Summer 2026 Buying Guide Tips
1.  **Look for 16GB of RAM Minimum:** Due to ongoing RAM price inflation impacting manufacturers, some budget models have dropped back to 8GB. Try to hunt for at least 16GB to ensure Windows 11 and background processes run smoothly.
2.  **Copilot+ Standards:** If you want a Windows machine that lasts, make sure it has an NPU (Neural Processing Unit) with 40+ TOPS (like Snapdragon X or Intel Ultra Series 3) to get true 20-hour battery life.
3.  **Should you wait?** With Prime Day officially happening **June 23–26**, you can pull the trigger now on early sales, but keep an eye out for potential flash drops during the actual event week.
